title: Stock Market Today Live, September 1: Nifty, Sensex trade range-bound amid banking sell-off - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 1st September 2026

Indian equity benchmarks traded in a narrow range at midday Tuesday, with the Nifty 50 up 0.04 per cent at 24,091.20 and the Sensex gaining 0.18 per cent at 77,098.16.

Selling in banking and financial stocks capped gains, while IT stocks provided support. HCL Technologies, ITC, Adani Ports, Bharti Airtel and Reliance Industries were among the top gainers, while Shriram Finance, Maruti Suzuki, Nestle India, Asian Paints and IndiGo declined.

Nifty IT was the best-performing sectoral index, while Nifty Realty lagged. Bank Nifty remained weak, moving within the 57,000–58,000 range amid pressure on frontline banking stocks.

Options data showed call writing at 24,200 and 24,300 strikes, with substantial put open interest at 24,100 and 24,000.

Crude oil extended gains for a fifth session amid geopolitical tensions, while gold consolidated and silver advanced. The rupee strengthened for a third session.

Nifty support stood at 24,020–24,000, with resistance at 24,250–24,270.

* Key support: 24,000 on Nifty 50; a decisive break could signal the next leg of decline.

* Nifty futures support: 24,150; breach can drag the contract towards 24,000 and 23,800.

* Key resistance: 24,300 on September futures; breakout could lift it towards 24,500.

* Trend: Bearish bias remains intact as Nifty trades below the opening level and the September futures show a bearish inclination.

* Market breadth: Nifty advance/decline ratio at 20:30, indicating bearish breadth.

* Sectoral cues: Nifty Auto is the top gainer, while Nifty Realty is the weakest sector.

* Trading trigger: Sell Nifty futures (September) on a break below 24,150, with an intraday target of 24,000 and stop-loss at 24,220.

Vikas Agrawal has joined Ujjivan Small Finance Bank as Business Head - MSME with effect from September 1, 2026.

In addition, Sanjeev Nautiyal, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer, expressed his desire to seek early retirement with a three-month notice period.

Shares declined over 4% to Rs 66.27 on the NSE.

Leading with market leader Maruti Suzuki India (MSIL), most of the passenger vehicles (PVs) manufacturers reported with a double digit growth on year-on-year (YoY) basis in their domestic wholesales (dispatches to dealers) in August, as demand continues and positive sentiments in the market.

Led by new launches and positive sentiments, two-wheeler makers also report double digit growth

Silver prices rose 0.19 per cent to ₹2.40 lakh per kg in the futures trade on Tuesday amid fresh position build-up by participants.

Silver futures rise to ₹2.4 lakh per kg as participants build fresh positions, analysts report.

Gold prices on Tuesday dropped by ₹208 to ₹1,54,252 per 10 grams in futures trade amid a fall in spot demand.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, yellow metal contracts for October delivery traded lower by ₹208, or 0.13 per cent, at ₹1,54,252 per 10 grams in a business turnover of 2,452 lots.

Analysts attributed the decline in precious metal prices to weaker spot demand. Globally, gold futures declined by 0.12 per cent to $4,432.26 per ounce in New York.

Aluminium futures are poised for a rally, maintaining a bullish trend and key support levels; consider holding long positions.

Gold Rate Today: Today's gold prices of 22, 24 carat up across metro cities on September 1

Gold Rate Today: Today's gold prices of 22, 24 carat up across other cities on September 1

El Niño intensifies in the Pacific, with record warming expected as the Indian Ocean Dipole remains neutral but may become positive.

Domestic GST revenue rose 9.3%, while revenue from imports jumped 29% in August, signalling continued strength in manufacturing and the formal economy.

Hazoor Multi Projects: NHAI withdrew the LOA for user fee collection at Paranur Fee Plaza as the plaza is proposed to shift to the MLFF tolling system, expected to be implemented by September 15, 2026.

Midwest accepted LOIs for three granite quarry leases in Andhra Pradesh under raising-cum-sale contracts

Shares traded at Rs 1070 on the NSE, down 2%.

TVS Motor Company, part of TVS VENU, recorded monthly sales growth of 21% with sales of 616,540 units in August 2026 as against 509,536 units in August 2025.

Shares traded at Rs 4,257.90 on the NSE, down 2%.

Ashok Leyland total vehicles sales in August 2026 stood at 21,038 units compared to 15,239 units in August 2025.

Shares traded at Rs 171.73 on the NSE, down 2%

Texmaco Rail & Engineering has informed the receipt of Letter of Award worth USD 135 Million from Tsiko Africa Logistics (Pty) Ltd. together with Barberry Holdings (Pty) Ltd.

Shares surged 4.5% to Rs 113.95 on the NSE.

Rupsha Chainani, chief research officer at Augmont, writes - Price Movement – Gold capped off August with a 9.4% gain, while silver surged 15% — the strongest monthly performance for gold, both in percentage terms and outright dollar gains, since February. That momentum hit some turbulence in the final stretch of the month, though, as Fed Chair Warsh’s hawkish tone at Jackson Hole combined with fresh flare-ups in the Strait of Hormuz to push oil prices higher and stoke inflation concerns — putting pressure on precious metals just as the month wound down.

· Geopolitical tensions – Tensions with Iran reignited on Monday after the first direct exchange of strikes in a month, prompting President Trump to warn of further military action — a sharp turn for a standoff that had, until recently, been playing out mostly on the economic front. Speaking to reporters in the Oval Office, Trump also weighed in on monetary policy, saying he holds Warsh in high regard and trusts him to “do what he has to do” on interest rates.

· Macro-Economic Signals – Markets have a busy data week ahead, with job openings, the ADP employment report, and nonfarm payrolls all due — each
